Problem Statement:
Write a program that finds the sum of absolute differences between alternate digits of a number.
Given a number, compute |d1 - d2| + |d3 - d4| + ... If the number has an odd count of digits, ignore the last digit. 
Input Description:
A single line containing a positive integer n 
Output Description:
A single integer: Sum of absolute differences between alternate digits 
Sample Input:
81462 
Sample Output:
9
